he: מִזְמ֗וֹר לְאָ֫סָ֥ף אֱֽלֹהִ֗ים נִצָּ֥ב בַּעֲדַת־אֵ֑ל בְּקֶ֖רֶב אֱלֹהִ֣ים יִשְׁפֹּֽט׃
en: A psalm of Asaf: Elokim stands in the congregation of Keil; in the midst of the judges He judges.
How long shall you judge unrighteously, and respect the persons of the wicked? Selah.
Judge the poor and fatherless; do justice to the afflicted and destitute.
Deliver the poor and needy; rescue them out of the hand of the wicked.

he: לֹ֤א יָדְע֨וּ ׀ וְלֹ֥א יָבִ֗ינוּ בַּחֲשֵׁכָ֥ה יִתְהַלָּ֑כוּ יִ֝מּ֗וֹטוּ כׇּל־מ֥וֹסְדֵי אָֽרֶץ׃
en: They know not, neither do they understand; they go about in darkness; all the foundations of the earth are moved.

he: אֲֽנִי־אָ֭מַרְתִּי אֱלֹהִ֣ים אַתֶּ֑ם וּבְנֵ֖י עֶלְי֣וֹן כֻּלְּכֶֽם׃
en: I said: You are Elokim, and all of you sons of the Most High.

he: אָ֭כֵן כְּאָדָ֣ם תְּמוּת֑וּן וּכְאַחַ֖ד הַשָּׂרִ֣ים תִּפֹּֽלוּ׃
en: Nevertheless you shall die like men, and fall like one of the princes.

he: קוּמָ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהִים שׇׁפְטָ֣ה הָאָ֑רֶץ כִּֽי־אַתָּ֥ה תִ֝נְחַ֗ל בְּכׇל־הַגּוֹיִֽם׃ {פ}
en: Arise, O Elokim, judge the earth; for You shall inherit all the nations.
